alloy.preparation: As-cast FeCoNiCr high-entropy alloy; arc melted from 99.99% pure Fe, Co, Ni, Cr and Cu metals under titanium-gettered argon. Electrode surface preparation and any subsequent heat treatment are not specified.

test_solution.preparation: Aerated solution, under atmospheric pressure. No gas-flow duration, pH or chloride-ion concentration is supplied.

test_method.procedure_description: Typical three-electrode cell: specimen working electrode, saturated calomel reference (SCE) and platinum counter electrode; working-electrode potential measured through a Luggin probe, with reference as close as possible to the specimen. Scanned from 250 mV below open-circuit potential to 1.6 V SCE. Calibration in accordance with ASTM G5 and G59. The 30-day immersion and subsequent HCl/hexamethylenetetramine cleaning are separate from this polarization experiment.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Table 5 explicitly defines Epit as pitting potential, derived from the anodic polarization curves in Figure 5. No numerical current-density criterion for selecting Epit is stated.

experiments.result_note: Composition is the Table 1 specimen EDX analysis in wt%, not the phase-specific Table 2 at% analysis. A table dash is not converted to zero or an inferred balance.

alloy.preparation: As-cast FeCoNiCrCu0.5 high-entropy alloy; arc melted from 99.99% pure Fe, Co, Ni, Cr and Cu metals under titanium-gettered argon. Electrode surface preparation and any subsequent heat treatment are not specified.
alloy.microstructure: Basically fcc structure by XRD. Dendritic structure with Cu-rich/Cr-depleted interdendrites and Cu-depleted/Cr-rich dendrites; additional Cu-rich fcc reflections identified for FeCoNiCrCu.
